comment: shk.c unpaid_cost() report from multi-object windows. Seed 8452217's Dlvl 4 has a weapon shop whose keeper stands at (54,5) inside an open door at (53,5); a debug-mode Samurai who level-teleports there lands at (58,3) on 10 darts (port-only scanSeeds() probe over 8452000-8452400 for a hero who lands on an object inside a shop with its keeper at home: 16 hits, this one chosen for its weapon shop). He picks up the darts (unpaid), hurls the keeper west through the door with #wiztelekinesis (wizcmds.c wiz_telekinesis() -> mhurtle()), wishes for a hole under himself (objnam.c wizterrainwish()) and plunges through it with '>'. shk.c u_left_shop() returns early because the keeper is not inhishop(), so the darts stay unpaid on Dlvl 5, where no bill holds them. He throws one dart down with 't' and '>' and drops the other nine with 'd', which leaves two unpaid stacks on his square. ':' then reaches invent.c look_here()'s window branch, which formats each object with doname_with_price() while it fills the text window (4306), so both reports come before "Things that are here:" appears. ',' builds pickup.c's "Pick up what?" menu with doname() for each entry, so both reports again come before the menu; Escape closes it. Seed, datetime, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session and batch game.
